name: Build Error & QA Explainer
blurb: a failed BitBake task log or QA warning classified, with the cause and the fix
intro: Paste a BitBake console log or a task log (log.do_fetch, log.do_compile, log.do_package_qa...). Every decisive line is matched against a rule table built from the messages BitBake and OE-Core print (fetch2, taskdata, insane.bbclass, sstate): fetch failures, missing DEPENDS, host contamination, the insane.bbclass QA checks, do_rootfs conflicts, signature errors and OOM. Each finding says what failed, why, and the recipe lines that fix it, in the override syntax of the release in the log.

usage: Pass the log text in `log` (console output or a temp/log.do_* file); `syntax` auto picks FILES:${PN} or FILES_${PN} from DISTRO_VERSION in the log; `warnings` false ignores WARNING lines. Returns a Findings table (level, kind/QA check, recipe, task, log line, one-line finding), a Failed tasks table, and texts 'Fixes' (per finding: what, why, the exact recipe/local.conf lines, the Yocto doc section) and 'Decisive lines'. Use it on any failed bitbake run before editing recipes; unclassified failures are listed with the task log to read.
sources: Yocto Project Reference Manual, 'QA Error and Warning Messages' (ref-manual/qa-checks) and the insane class (ref-manual/classes, ERROR_QA / WARN_QA)
OE-Core meta/classes-global/insane.bbclass, meta/lib/oe/package.py, meta/lib/oe/qa.py (message texts, check names; read from a scarthgap checkout)
BitBake lib/bb/fetch2/__init__.py and git.py (Checksum mismatch, Unable to find revision, BB_NO_NETWORK), lib/bb/taskdata.py (Nothing PROVIDES), lib/bb/siggen.py (Taskhash mismatch)
GCC 10 and GCC 14 porting notes (-fno-common, implicit-function-declaration); header/pkg-config to recipe maps are OE-Core/meta-oe recipe names, a starting point to confirm with oe-pkgdata-util
